purpose: Requirements defining the reviewer behavior: how it reads targets, determines target type, which documents it uses per type, what findings it returns, and its single error value.
summary: Reviewer purpose: find errors without omission using norms suited to the target
Scope: reviewer-specific behavior; common exchange contract is delegated; secret detection is out of scope
FNC-301: contents of the reviewer definition, including script usage and request item handling
FNC-306: reading targets by shape (paths, base_branch, diff), including deletions and renames
FNC-307: target type determination into code, requirement, design, plan, uxui via doc structure config then file reading
FNC-308: documents per target type, common set plus type-specific criteria, norms, project rules and cross-check targets
FNC-309: findings are returned only when present; zero findings means normal completion
FNC-315: the only error value is target_unreadable; unreadable documents get no error value
Undetermined target type is reviewed with common documents only, not an error
